• Kerala Blasters FC vs Mumbai City FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 16 || 25-Oct-2026 || English ||
Honours even in Kochi! Watch the big moments as Kerala Blasters FC and Mumbai City FC played out a 0-0 draw in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Kerala Blasters bounced back from their 4-1 defeat in Guwahati with a clean sheet at home, which also ended a two-match losing run against the Islanders. Mumbai City are now three games into the season without a win, and their last two have both ended level.
